name: achmage-video-script
description: Write on-screen-text video scripts (화면 문장 대본) that tell one complete story with captions and scenes and no narrator, in the manner of EBS 지식채널e: beat sheets, card-by-card writing, matching scene suggestions, production hand-off fields, automatic checks and a rough-cut sheet.
